headline: Approved $198,720 VMware VSphere contract with GovConnection, Inc.; held public hearing on road fund increase from $1,000,000 to $2,000,000.
summary: The board held a public hearing on Resolution R-26-053, which would raise the special revenue fund for road and highway expenditures from motor vehicle permit fees from $1,000,000 to $2,000,000; no one spoke for or against it. The board then approved a three-year contract with GovConnection, Inc. for VMware VSphere Foundation software, not to exceed $198,720 total ($66,240 annually), funded through the Technology Maintenance department and General Fund/Property Services.
decisions: Approved a three-year contract with GovConnection, Inc. for VMware VSphere Foundation, not to exceed $198,720 ($66,240 annually), funded through Department 120 Technology Maintenance, General Fund/54-Property Services.

decision_evidence.quote: MOTION BY ALDERMAN KLEE TO ACCEPT, PLACE ON FILE, AND APPROVE A CONTRACT FOR A THREE (3) YEAR TERM RENEWAL REQUIRED FOR THE OPERATION OF VMWARE VSPHERE FOUNDATION THROUGH GOVCONNECTION, INC. IN THE AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $198,720 ($66,240 ANNUALLY)...MOTION CARRIED

plain_text:
A special meeting of the Board of Aldermen was held Monday, August 24, 2026, at 7:00 p.m. in the 
aldermanic chamber and duly noticed in two places, including the City’s website, in accordance with the 
requirements of RSA 91-A:2 II. 
 
President Lori Wilshire presided; City Clerk Dan Healey recorded. 
 
Prayer was offered by City Clerk Dan Healey; Alderman James Ravan led in the Pledge to the Flag. 
 
Let’s start the meeting by taking a roll call attendance.   
 
City Clerk Healey called the roll. 
 
The roll call was taken with 10 members of the Board of Aldermen present:  Alderman Klee, Alderman 
Ravan, Alderman Thibeault, Alderman O’Brien, Alderman Gregg, Alderman Dowd, Alderman Sennott, 
Alderman Johnson, Alderman Morgan, President Wilshire.       
 
Alderman Clemons, Alderwoman Smith, Alderman Sullivan, Alderwoman Kelly, Alderman Lopez were 
recorded absent. 
 
Also in attendance was Mayor Jim Donchess and Corporation Counsel Steve Bolton. 
 
President Wilshire to turn the meeting over to Chairman Dowd. 
 
PUBLIC HEARING 
 
R-26-053 
AMENDING THE SPECIAL REVENUE FUND FOR ROAD AND HIGHWAY EXPENDITURES BY INCREASING 
THE ANNUAL FUNDING AMOUNT FROM MOTOR VEHICLE PERMIT FEES FROM $1,000,000 TO $2,000,000 
 
 
Testimony in Favor - None 
 
 
Testimony in Opposition - None 
 
 
Testimony in Favor - None 
 
 
Testimony in Opposition - None 
 
 
Chairman Dowd closed the public hearing on Resolution R-26-053 at 7:27 p.m. 
 
 
PUBLIC COMMENT - None 
 
 
COMMUNICATIONS REQUIRING FINAL APPROVAL  
 
From:  Mayor Jim Donchess 
Re:      Multi-year Contract Award – Gov Connection, Inc.   
 
 
MOTION BY ALDERMAN KLEE TO ACCEPT, PLACE ON FILE, AND APPROVE  A CONTRACT FOR A 
THREE (3) YEAR TERM RENEWAL REQUIRED FOR THE OPERATION OF VMWARE VSPHERE
Special Board of Aldermen                                          08-24-2026                         Page 2 
 
FOUNDATION THROUGH GOVCONNECTION, INC. IN THE AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $198,720 
($66,240 ANNUALLY).  FUNDING WILL BE THROUGH DEPARTMENT:  120 TECHNOLOGY 
MAINTENANCE; FUND:  GENERAL FUND/54-PROPERTY SERVICES 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
 
ADJOURNMENT 
 
MOTION BY ALDERMAN WILSHIRE THAT THE AUGUST 24, 2026 SPECIAL MEETING OF THE 
BOARD OF ALDERMEN BE ADJOURNED 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
 
The meeting was declared adjourned at 7:28 p.m.   
 
                Attest:  Michael B. O’Brien, Sr.
